Direction, infinitive and recipient are separate usages.
Inflect possessor rather than inserting a universal preposition.
Preposition, accusative in the current simplified grammar.

Subject may be omitted when clear.

Comparative or role-marking as not standardized.
General do/place; some English 'do' is auxiliary with no direct equivalent.

Genitive of so, not a universal possessive suffix.
Agent/means/near are distinct senses requiring rules.
Speak is covered, but quote/report 'say/tell' needs dedicated usage.
Future marker, not English volitional noun/verb.

Interrogative; temporal subordinating when not yet defined.

Similarity, enjoyment, and examples are distinct.

Answer particle (also ne = not in standard grammar).
Recognize/know; more abstract knowledge in vidom.

Goal location: en + accusative; distinguish at-rest vs motion in context.
Adjective with gender and case endings.
Direction/return and bodily back require distinctions.
Use as verb or noun needs lexical choice.
Ordinal first not defined; need numeral ordinal rule.
Adjective with regular gender and cases.
Finite causal clause connector; pro tod for 'because of that'.
